20261122-physics-e1-1.goal: Aiwatar da ka'idojin Bincike mai zurfi don warware matsalar bincike.
20261122-physics-e1-1.material: [Bincike mai zurfi] Idan aka ɗaure tsakiyar sandar maganaɗisu da zare aka rataye ta daga rufi aka bar ta ta tsaya, maganaɗisu yana girgiza na ɗan lokaci sannan ya tsaya yana nuni zuwa wata hanya ta musamman koyaushe. Menene dalili?
20261122-physics-e1-1.s.s1.prompt: [Bincike mai zurfi] Idan aka ɗaure tsakiyar sandar maganaɗisu da zare aka rataye ta daga rufi aka bar ta ta tsaya, maganaɗisu yana girgiza na ɗan lokaci sannan ya tsaya yana nuni zuwa wata hanya ta musamman koyaushe. Menene dalili?

20261122-physics-e2-1.steps.0.prompt: [Tunani mai zurfi] An sa agogon ƙararrawa a cikin kwandon gilashi mara iska (vacuum) aka sa ƙararrawar ta yi ƙara. Hannayen agogon suna girgiza suna bugun kararrawa, amma ba a jin wani sauti. Menene dalili?
20261122-physics-e2-1.steps.0.explain: Ana isar da sauti ta girgizar wani abu (matsakaici) kamar iska, don haka a cikin vacuum da babu iska sauti ba ya isa.
20261122-physics-e2-1.steps.0.hints.0: Don sauti ya isa kunnenmu, yana buƙatar wani abu da zai isar da shi kamar iska.
20261122-physics-e2-1.steps.0.hints.1: A cikin vacuum babu ƙwayoyin iskar gas ko ɗaya.
20261122-physics-e2-1.steps.0.options.0.text: Domin babu iska (matsakaici) da za ta isar da sauti
20261122-physics-e2-1.steps.0.options.1.text: Domin a cikin vacuum sauti yana canzawa zuwa haske
20261122-physics-e2-1.steps.0.options.2.text: Domin bangon gilashi ya shanye duk sautin
20261122-physics-e2-1.steps.0.options.3.text: Domin girgizar agogon ta yi sauri sosai

20261122-physics-e2-2.title: Idan aka buga xylophone
20261122-physics-e2-2.goal: Aiwatar da ka'idojin Idan aka buga xylophone don warware matsalar bincike.
20261122-physics-e2-2.material: Idan aka buga xylophone, wane ne kwatancen tsayin sautin madannai gajere da dogo da ke daidai?
20261122-physics-e2-2.s.s1.prompt: Idan aka buga xylophone, wane ne kwatancen tsayin sautin madannai gajere da dogo da ke daidai?
20261122-physics-e2-2.s.s1.explain: Idan madanni ya fi gajarta, adadin girgizar abin a cikin daƙiƙa guda (mita) yana ƙaruwa, don haka sautin yana yin tsayi; idan ya fi tsayi, mita yana raguwa sautin kuma yana yin ƙasa.
20261122-physics-e2-2.s.s1.hint.0: Idan abu ya fi gajarta kuma sirara, yana girgiza da sauri a cikin daƙiƙa guda.
20261122-physics-e2-2.s.s1.hint.1: Idan yawan girgiza ya fi yawa, sautin yana da tsayi.
20261122-physics-e2-2.s.s1.o.o0: Gajeren madanni yana girgiza da sauri ya fitar da sauti mai tsayi
20261122-physics-e2-2.s.s1.o.o1: Dogon madanni yana fitar da sauti mai tsayi
20261122-physics-e2-2.s.s1.o.o2: Tsawon madanni da tsayin sauti ba su da wata alaƙa
20261122-physics-e2-2.s.s1.o.o3: Gajeren madanni ba ya fitar da sauti ko kaɗan
